title: Qwen3.8 LiveTranslate adds real-time translation across 60 languages
summary: Alibaba Cloud added Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate-Flash-Realtime, a WebSocket translation model that accepts audio plus image context and streams translated text and audio. It understands 60 source languages and can synthesize speech in 29 languages; unlike a general agent model, it does not support function calling or web search.
hardware: Cloud-hosted through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio; client hardware mainly needs to stream audio/images over WebSocket.
best_use_cases: Live multilingual meetings, interpretation, translated calls and audiovisual translation
worth_testing: Yes if real-time translation matters; test latency, speaker handling and terminology on your own language pairs before production use.
confidence: High for availability and documented capabilities; comparative quality/latency claims need independent testing.
discovered_via: Web discovery; verified against Alibaba Cloud primary documentation

title: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash brings 1M-context audio/video understanding to Model Studio
summary: Alibaba Cloud now documents Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash for text, image, audio and video input with text output, a 1M-token context window, adjustable thinking, custom function calling, web search and context caching. It is aimed at long audio/video analysis rather than speech output.
hardware: Cloud-hosted through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio; no local accelerator requirement for inference.
best_use_cases: Meeting summaries, long video/audio analysis, subtitles, multimodal extraction and tool-using media workflows
worth_testing: Yes for long-form audio/video analysis; compare accuracy and cost against Gemini/OpenAI on representative media.
confidence: High for documented capabilities and availability; vendor benchmark comparisons are not treated as independently established.
discovered_via: Web discovery; verified against Alibaba Cloud primary documentation
